columns.title: For small businesses
columns.text: No need to hire an SMM manager, a designer and an ads specialist separately. One team runs your page, shoots video and sets up ads.

pricing.title: Packages & *pricing*
pricing.note: Ad budget is not included. Branding and websites are priced separately.

audit.title: Free audit — *within 24 hours*
audit.text: We review your page and show you, in a 3–5 minute video, where customers are getting lost. No strings attached.
